source_note: Verified Bible Knowledge Form One schemes of work (Arusha Major Seminary, ARUCASE) for Term I and Term II. 2 periods per week (1 x 80-min double period + 1 x 40-min single period). Term I covers Chapters 1-2 (main competences 1.0-2.0); Term II covers Chapters 3-4 (main competences 3.0-4.0). Week 10 of each term is mid-term assessment and holiday.
